prompt.zh-TW: 三位同學要替綠茵運動用品的課堂報告算一個本益比，爭論分母該用哪一個每股盈餘。三個選擇都說得通，你會選哪一個？
prompt.en: Three students preparing a class report on Greenfield Sports disagree about which earnings per share to use as the denominator of the P/E ratio. All three choices can be defended; which would you pick?

text.zh-TW: 用去年經過查核的實際每股盈餘
text.en: Use last year’s audited actual earnings per share

upside.zh-TW: 數字已經發生而且查核過，任何人都能重算，不會被樂觀的預估帶著走。
upside.en: The figure is already reported and audited; anyone can recompute it, and it cannot be swayed by an optimistic forecast.

downside.zh-TW: 反映的是過去；公司如果正在轉變，去年的盈餘可能已經不代表現在。
downside.en: It reflects the past; if the company is changing, last year’s earnings may no longer represent it.

text.zh-TW: 用公司公告的今年預估每股盈餘
text.en: Use the company’s published forecast for this year

upside.zh-TW: 比較貼近接下來的狀況，和市場定價時看的方向一致。
upside.en: Closer to what lies ahead, and in line with the direction the market looks when pricing.

downside.zh-TW: 預估可能落空，也可能偏樂觀；用它算出的倍數看起來低，不代表真的便宜。
downside.en: Forecasts can miss and may lean optimistic; a multiple that looks low on a forecast is not necessarily cheap.

text.zh-TW: 用過去三年的平均每股盈餘
text.en: Use the average earnings per share of the past three years

upside.zh-TW: 能平滑掉單一年度的一次性損益，對景氣起伏大的公司比較穩。
upside.en: Smooths out one-off items in any single year, steadier for companies with cyclical results.

downside.zh-TW: 對快速成長或快速衰退的公司反應太慢，平均數可能和現況差很遠。
downside.en: Reacts too slowly for fast-growing or fast-declining companies; the average may be far from the present.

viewpoint.zh-TW: 三個分母都有人用，重點不是選出唯一正確的那個，而是說清楚你用的是哪一個、為什麼，並把一次性項目分開看。如果你最在意可驗證，選實際數；最在意貼近未來，選預估並標示不確定性；最在意穩定，選平均。本章是會計觀念練習，不是投資建議。
viewpoint.en: All three denominators are in use. The point is not to find the one right answer but to state which you used and why, and to separate one-off items. If you value verifiability most, use the actual figure; if you value closeness to the future, use the forecast and flag its uncertainty; if you value stability, use the average. This chapter is an accounting concept exercise, not investment advice.

explanation.zh-TW: 這一題沒有標準答案；送出之後會看到三個做法各自的理由。
explanation.en: There is no single right answer here; once you submit, you will see the reasoning behind all three choices.
